chunks: The upper hand is better than the lower hand.

key_terms.الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى: the lower hand; meaning the receiving or dependent hand
key_terms.اَلْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا: the upper hand; meaning the giving or supporting hand
key_terms.خَيْرٌ: better, more virtuous, and more excellent

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith "The upper hand is better than the lower hand" mean?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches the virtue of giving over receiving. It praises generosity, self-sufficiency, and honorable support of others in social and financial life.
